modern: See that you secure this present time for yourself: for those who would rather pursue fame after death do not consider that the men of later times will be exactly like these whom they cannot bear now; and both are mortal. And what is it in any way to you if these men of later times make this or that sound, or have this or that opinion about you?
original: See that thou secure this present time to thyself: for those who rather pursue posthumous fame do not consider that the men of after time will be exactly such as these whom they cannot bear now; and both are mortal. And what is it in any way to thee if these men of after time utter this or that sound, or have this or that opinion about thee?
